top_signals.title: Emerging Market Stocks Rise on AI Revival as Currency Gains Fade
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market stocks rose on Thursday, boosted by a resurgence in the artificial-intelligence trade, while currencies gave up earlier gains amid lingering concerns over the Middle East conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao is leading early IPO meetings with investors and has not discussed valuation, sources say
top_signals.summary: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao is leading early investor meetings, which have focused on big-picture themes like its Claude AI models, management and more.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Housing Crisis Fuels Surge in Mortgage Muni Bond Securitizations
top_signals.summary: The nation’s affordable-housing shortage is fueling a fast-growing corner of the municipal bond market, as lenders securitize portfolios of multifamily mortgages to free up capital for new loans.
